# prismasdwan_sdwanapp (Data Source)

Looks up one Prisma SD-WAN app by its exact name and lists its releases. Read-only: use the id and one of the versions with prismasdwan_sdwanapps_config to install the app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find an SD-WAN app by its exact name; the id and the versions are what prismasdwan_sdwanapps_config needs.
data "prismasdwan_sdwanapp" "email" {
  name = "Email Notifications For Alarm-Alerts"
}

output "email_app_id" {
  value = data.prismasdwan_sdwanapp.email.id
}

# all releases of the app: 1.5.0, 1.4.0, ...
output "email_app_versions" {
  value = data.prismasdwan_sdwanapp.email.versions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact name of the app, for example "Email Notifications For Alarm-Alerts". Names are unique.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the app.
- `id` (String) Id of the app, the app_id of prismasdwan_sdwanapps_config.
- `releases` (Attributes List) Releases of the app. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--releases))
- `tags` (List of String) Tags of the app.
- `versions` (List of String) Versions of all releases, in the order the API returns them. An app is installed with one version.

<a id="nestedatt--releases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `releases`

Read-Only:

- `default_release` (Boolean) Whether this is the default release.
- `description` (String) Description of the release.
- `name` (String) Name of the release.
- `parameters_json` (String) JSON list that describes the user_config of this release (key, type, required, default_value, list_values, ...). Decode it with jsondecode().
- `release_date` (Number) Release date, seconds since the epoch.
- `state` (String) State of the release: ga, beta, alpha or deprecated.
- `version` (String) Version of the release, for example 1.5.0.
